replay-element-help-follow-entity: Follow rig between a Start and an End keyframe: third person (distance, height, orbit) or first person. Choose the player by name in the keyframe. Outside the interval the other cameras take over.
replay-element-help-camera-shake: Adds sine-wave wobble on top of whatever camera is active. Frequency is in Hz, amplitude in degrees; amplitude is interpolated between keyframes, so ramp it from 0 up and back to 0. See the shake presets below.
replay-element-help-fov: Changes the field of view over time on top of any camera (lower = zoomed in). Values interpolate between keyframes and the last one is held.
replay-element-help-speed: Changes playback speed from this point (slow motion below 1x, fast forward above). The value is held after the last keyframe, so add a keyframe back at normal speed.
replay-element-help-timelapse: Plays a stretch of the replay compressed into the chosen duration. Drag the start/end of the interval on the timeline.
replay-element-help-time-of-day: Overrides the world time of day (0-24000; 6000 = noon). Interpolate between keyframes for a sunset or night fall.
replay-element-help-freeze: Freezes the world (entities, particles) at a keyframe while the camera can keep moving; add another keyframe with Frozen off to resume. Freeze delay waits that many ticks first.
replay-preset-no-player: VS Director: this replay has no recorded player or entity to target.
replay-browser-favorite: Add to favourites (or right-click the row, Ctrl+D)
replay-browser-favorites-empty: No favourites yet. Click the star next to a preset (or right-click it, or press Ctrl+D) to pin it here.
replay-browser-recent-empty: Nothing used yet. Presets and elements you add show up here.
replay-browser-needs-player: Needs a recorded player: uses the selected keyframe's player, else you, else the first recorded player.
replay-browser-keys: Up/Down select · Enter add · Left/Right category · PgUp/PgDn jump · Ctrl+D favourite
replay-preset-failed: VS Director: preset "{0}" failed, see client log.
replay-preset-no-second-actor: VS Director: no second player or creature nearby to frame.
replay-preset-no-creature: VS Director: no living creature near the player.
replay-preset-no-combat: VS Director: no hits near the player in the next 2 minutes.
replay-preset-no-death: VS Director: nobody dies after the playhead.
replay-preset-no-highlights: VS Director: found no deaths, fights, speech or building bursts.
replay-preset-no-building: VS Director: no block edits in the next 10 minutes.
replay-preset-nothing-boring: VS Director: no long quiet stretches found, nothing to speed up.
replay-element-help-color-grade: Animated colour grade over the picture: sepia, contrast, vignette, bloom, glitch and fade to black. Values blend between keyframes.
replay-element-help-title: Shows a title card (text and subtitle) for a set time, fading in and out. Lower third, centre or top.
replay-follow-world-aligned: Orbit angle is a map direction
replay-visual-camera-avoid-occlusion: Keep subject visible (pull camera in front of walls)
replay-preset-follow-side-scroller-help: 8 s side view locked to your current viewing direction (not the player's facing), 6 blocks out. 2D platformer look for parkour and running.
replay-preset-follow-top-down-help: 8 s from 12 blocks straight above, map-aligned. Strategy-game view of movement and fights.
replay-preset-follow-satellite-help: 12 s from 60 blocks up with a narrow FOV. Map-style view of a long journey.
replay-preset-follow-back-to-face-help: 5 s that starts behind the player and swings round (ease in-out) to reveal the face.
replay-preset-follow-crane-up-help: 8 s rising from shoulder level to 15 blocks while pulling back. Ending shot.
replay-preset-follow-crane-down-help: 8 s descending from high up to the shoulder. Opening shot that lands on the character.
replay-preset-follow-pull-away-help: 10 s with the player centred while the distance grows from 3 to 30. Lonely departure ending.
replay-preset-follow-whip-in-help: Rushes from 25 blocks to 3 in 2.5 s (accelerating), then holds 3 s. Dramatic arrival on the character.
replay-preset-follow-fall-cam-help: 6 s camera 4 blocks above the player, looking down as they fall or dive. Cliff jumps and long drops.
replay-preset-track-tripod-help: 8 s camera stays where it is now and pans to keep the player centred. Documentary or sports look.
replay-preset-track-shaky-operator-help: 8 s fixed camera whose pan lags behind the subject, with a light handheld shake. Amateur feel.
replay-preset-track-cctv-help: 8 s from a high corner (8 out, 6 up) at FOV 95, rigid, slightly washed out. CCTV look.
replay-preset-track-flyby-help: 4 s camera sweeps along a straight line past the player while staying aimed at them. Racing flyby.
replay-preset-track-flyover-help: 3 s camera passes fast overhead from behind you to beyond the player, aimed at them.
replay-preset-track-switch-subject-help: Fixed camera looks at the player, then pans (1 s, eased) to the nearest other actor and holds. Reactions and handoffs.
replay-preset-track-auto-zoom-help: 10 s fixed camera whose FOV adjusts on its own so the player stays the same size on screen.
replay-preset-track-two-shot-help: 8 s fixed camera aimed between the player and the nearest other actor, zooming so both fit.
replay-preset-track-group-help: 10 s fixed camera that frames every recorded player. Group shots and raids.
replay-preset-track-over-shoulder-help: 8 s camera behind the player's shoulder looking at the nearest other actor. Dialogue staple.
replay-preset-orbit-build-showcase-help: 24 s slow 360° around the block you are looking at, 35° from above, at least 20 blocks out. Shows off builds.
replay-preset-orbit-turntable-help: 12 s close, level, constant-speed turn around the looked-at block. Product shot for a statue or display.
replay-preset-orbit-spiral-up-help: 14 s orbit that rises and widens (8 → 35 blocks). Epic reveal of a base or town.
replay-preset-orbit-spiral-in-help: 12 s orbit that descends and closes in (35 → 6 blocks). Focuses on one detail.
replay-preset-orbit-parallax-arc-help: 8 s gentle 90° arc around the looked-at point, eased. Subtle depth movement for B-roll.
replay-preset-orbit-dizzy-help: 6 s fast orbit (two turns) around the player with a rolling wobble and sway. Poisoned, drunk or concussed.
replay-preset-move-dolly-in-help: Slides 5 blocks forward over 6 s. Slow approach.
replay-preset-move-dolly-out-help: Slides 5 blocks back over 6 s. Leaving a scene.
replay-preset-move-truck-left-help: Slides 6 blocks left over 6 s. Parallax across a scene.
replay-preset-move-truck-right-help: Slides 6 blocks right over 6 s. Parallax across a scene.
replay-preset-move-pedestal-up-help: Rises 6 blocks straight up over 6 s.
replay-preset-move-crane-reveal-help: 7 s starting low and behind, rising 11 blocks and tilting down to reveal what is beyond a hill or wall.
replay-preset-move-tilt-reveal-help: 6 s tilt from the ground up to the horizon. Reveals a tall tower or tree.
replay-preset-move-landscape-pan-help: Slow 90° pan to the right over 12 s. Scenery.
replay-preset-move-whip-pan-help: 90° pan in 0.25 s. Transition between two subjects.
replay-preset-move-vertigo-help: 5 s dolly toward the looked-at point while the FOV widens so the subject keeps its size and the background warps.
replay-preset-move-reverse-vertigo-help: 5 s dolly away while the FOV narrows. The background closes in behind the subject.
replay-preset-move-barrel-roll-help: Full 360° roll in 1 s. Stylish transition.
replay-preset-move-dutch-creep-help: Roll eases from 0 to 15° over 6 s. Slowly building tension.
replay-preset-move-snap-zoom-help: Instant cut to half the FOV, held for 3 s. Comedy beat.
replay-preset-move-crash-zoom-help: FOV slams to 20° in 0.15 s with a small shake, holds 2 s. Horror or comedy 'oh no' moment.
replay-preset-move-establishing-help: Holds the current wide view for 4 s, then slowly pushes 4 blocks in. Scene opener.
replay-preset-move-drop-in-help: 3.5 s fall from 80 blocks straight above the subject down to a shoulder view behind it.
replay-preset-move-rise-to-sky-help: 8 s rising 40 blocks while tilting up toward the clouds. Ending or death.
replay-preset-move-ground-skim-help: 3 s just above the ground, rushing 30 blocks forward. Sense of speed (flat ground works best).
replay-preset-move-through-wall-help: 4 s straight 12 blocks forward, passing through whatever is in front. Reveals a room or cave.
replay-preset-move-corner-peek-help: 2.5 s slide out sideways from cover (2 blocks left to 2 right). Stealth or suspense.
replay-preset-move-handheld-drift-help: 6 s small random drift plus handheld shake. Found-footage look.
replay-preset-shake-handheld-help: About 9 s of subtle slow sway, like a handheld camera. Fades in and out.
replay-preset-shake-walk-help: About 7 s of a step-like vertical bob for walking shots.
replay-preset-shake-tension-help: 10 s slow, uneasy drift that builds and fades. Works well under suspense.
replay-preset-shake-impact-help: A sharp 0.4 s jolt for hits, falls or a door slam.
replay-preset-shake-explosion-help: Violent instant shake that decays over 1.6 s.
replay-preset-shake-earthquake-help: Builds for 1 s, rumbles for 3 s, then calms down over 1.5 s.
replay-preset-shake-heartbeat-help: About 7 s of double-pulse thumps every 0.9 s. Low health or fear.
replay-preset-shake-giant-steps-help: 6 heavy thuds 1.4 s apart. Something big is approaching.
replay-preset-shake-distant-rumble-help: 12 s long, very low, slow rumble. A temporal storm or thunder on its way.
replay-preset-shake-boat-sway-help: 16 s slow roll and pitch sway. Sailing.
replay-preset-shake-gallop-help: 9 s rhythmic vertical bob. Riding a mount.
replay-preset-shake-drunk-help: 14 s large slow sway with roll. Alcohol effect.
replay-preset-shake-rattle-help: 6.6 s fast tiny vibration. Carts, windmills, machinery.
replay-preset-shake-landing-help: One heavy vertical dip and recovery. Landing a big fall.
replay-preset-shake-temporal-storm-help: 13 s chaotic shake escalating over 10 s, with a glitch tint. Vintage Story's temporal storm.
replay-preset-shake-anxiety-help: 9 s barely visible fast jitter. Subtle nervousness.
replay-preset-fov-punch-in-help: Fast zoom in (−22°) in 0.35 s, holds for 2 s, then eases back to the current FOV.
replay-preset-fov-push-in-help: Slowly narrows the FOV by 20° over 6 s and holds it there.
replay-preset-fov-reveal-help: Widens the FOV by 25° over 3 s to reveal the surroundings, then holds.
replay-preset-fov-pulse-help: Quick outward FOV kick that settles back within 0.6 s.
replay-preset-fov-breathe-help: 12 s slow ±3° oscillation. The camera feels alive.
replay-preset-fov-sprint-help: Widens 15° over 1 s, holds 4 s, eases back. Speed feel.
replay-preset-fov-telephoto-help: Eases to 20° and holds 6 s. Compression and isolation.
replay-preset-fov-fisheye-help: Jumps out to 115° for 8 s. Skate-video energy.
replay-preset-fov-creep-help: Narrows 0.5°/s for 20 s, then eases back. Tension you don't notice.
replay-preset-speed-ramp-help: 1x to 0.25x in 0.4 s, hold 3 s, back to 1x. Action speed ramp.
replay-preset-speed-bullet-time-help: World slows to 0.1x for 5 s while the camera keeps real speed and orbits 180° round the player. The skipped replay time is jumped over afterwards.
replay-preset-speed-freeze-orbit-help: Freezes the world for 5 s and orbits 180° round the player. Frozen-moment showcase.
replay-preset-speed-hitstop-help: 0.1 s freeze on the hit plus an impact shake. Makes combat feel punchy.
replay-preset-speed-stutter-help: Four micro-freezes in a row (anime impact frames) over 1 s.
replay-preset-speed-fast-forward-help: 4x for the next 10 replay seconds. Skips boring travel.
replay-preset-speed-hyperlapse-help: The next 60 replay seconds play in 6 s while the camera glides 30 blocks forward. Long journey in seconds.
replay-preset-speed-rewind-help: Runs the replay back 3 s in 1 s with a glitch tint, then replays those 3 s. 'Wait, let's see that again.'
replay-preset-tod-golden-hour-help: Sets the time to warm sunset light from the playhead on.
replay-preset-tod-nightfall-help: Evening fades to night over 8 s.
replay-preset-sky-green-screen-help: Green sky for compositing and a camera locked at the current view for 10 s.
replay-preset-weather-storm-mood-help: Storm weather, late-evening light and a 12 s distant rumble.
replay-preset-tragic-slowmo-help: Movie-style 'something terrible happened' shot: a face-on camera locked to the player's head, the FOV slowly closes into a close-up (26°) while the replay slows to 0.3x, holds, then everything eases back after 7 s. Put the playhead just before the moment (death, hit, loss).
replay-preset-tragic-help: Same head-focused face-on close-up with the narrowing FOV, at normal speed.
replay-preset-impact-hit-help: Impact shake plus an FOV pulse at the playhead. Use on hits and landings.
replay-preset-cine-intro-help: Golden hour, a 6 s establishing crane, then an 8 s descent onto the player's shoulder. Video opener.
replay-preset-cine-outro-help: 10 s pull-away and rise from the player, fading to black at the end. Video ending.
replay-preset-cine-hero-landing-help: Low hero angle, a speed ramp, landing shake and FOV pulse. Place just before touchdown.
replay-preset-cine-victory-spin-help: Fast orbit round the player, an FOV pulse and slight slow-motion for 6 s.
replay-preset-cine-boss-intro-help: Fixed camera tracks the nearest creature and pushes in for 4 s, then freezes with its name card for 2.5 s.
replay-preset-cine-jump-scare-help: Calm static shot for 2.5 s, then a sudden crash zoom, impact shake and contrast spike.
replay-preset-cine-chase-help: 15 s alternating chase cam and leading shot every 3 s.
replay-preset-cine-arrival-help: 8 s telephoto (18°) from 40 blocks ahead of the player, who walks toward the camera.
replay-preset-cine-build-timelapse-help: The next 120 replay seconds play in 12 s while the camera circles the looked-at build once.
replay-preset-cine-death-help: World slows to 0.3x, the camera cranes up over the player looking down and the colour drains away (7 s).
replay-preset-cine-trailer-help: Eight fast 1.2 s cuts between angles on the player, each with an FOV punch.
replay-preset-style-sports-broadcast-hel: 10 s high sideline camera (25 out, 10 up) at 28° that glides along with the player.
replay-preset-style-nature-doc-help: 12 s long-lens tripod with a slow pan, tracking the nearest animal (or the player).
replay-preset-style-symmetric-help: Squares the camera to the nearest 90°, levels it, turns on the centre guide and trucks sideways for 8 s.
replay-preset-style-noir-help: Dutch angle, night, rain and a high-contrast monochrome grade for 12 s.
replay-preset-style-dream-help: 10 s of 0.6x speed, breathing FOV, a slow drift and soft bloom.
replay-preset-style-found-footage-help: 10 s handheld drift, nervous jitter, wide FOV and a harsh vignette.
replay-preset-style-silent-film-help: 15 s at a choppy 12 fps with a sepia, high-contrast, vignetted grade.
replay-preset-follow-shoulder-help: 8 s third-person follow just behind and slightly right of the player's head (2.2 m, quick smoothing). Good for walking and dialogue.
replay-preset-follow-chase-help: 8 s classic third-person chase camera, 5 m back and 1.5 m up with gentle smoothing.
replay-preset-follow-wide-help: 8 s distant, high and slow-moving follow (14 m, narrow 55° FOV). Shows the player inside the landscape.
replay-preset-follow-pov-help: 8 s through the player's eyes with no smoothing.
replay-preset-follow-front-help: 8 s camera in front of the player looking back at their face (orbit angle 180°). Good for reactions or walking toward the camera.
replay-preset-follow-orbit-help: 8 s follow that circles the player at 20°/s, 6 m away.
replay-preset-follow-drone-help: 8 s high camera that trails the player with a 1 s delay, like a drone catching up.
replay-preset-follow-low-hero-help: 8 s camera below the waist, 3 blocks back, looking up. Makes the player look big and powerful.
replay-preset-follow-left-shoulder-help: 8 s over the left shoulder. Pair with the right-shoulder rig to alternate sides between cuts.
replay-preset-follow-hip-help: 8 s very close (1.2 blocks), low and to the side. Action-game feel for combat.
replay-preset-follow-lead-help: 8 s camera 6 blocks in front, moving backwards as the player walks toward it. Classic tunnel walk.
replay-preset-follow-lazy-help: 8 s with a 2.5 s delay, 8 blocks back. The camera lags and catches up like a reacting operator.
replay-preset-follow-locked-help: 8 s rigid, no smoothing. Helmet-cam or bolted-to-the-boat feel.
replay-preset-follow-telephoto-help: 8 s from 18 blocks back at FOV 25. Compressed background, long-lens sports look.
replay-preset-follow-intro-orbit-help: 10 s slow orbit (8°/s) at face height, 2.5 blocks out, starting from the front-side.
replay-preset-follow-hype-spin-help: 6 s fast orbit (60°/s). Victories, dances, showing off gear.
replay-preset-follow-cave-help: 8 s at 1.8 blocks with quick smoothing and clear-view on. For tunnels and mines (needs the ClearView mod for see-through).
replay-preset-follow-forest-clear-help: 8 s wide follow with clear-view on, so leaves and trunks don't hide the player.
replay-preset-follow-stabilized-pov-help: 8 s first person with smoothing. Removes mouse jitter so POV footage is watchable.
replay-preset-follow-dutch-help: 8 s shoulder rig rolled 12°. Unease and tension.
replay-preset-smart-auto-director-help: Directs the next minute on its own: talking players get close-ups, fights get tight action angles, travel gets chase and wide shots.
replay-preset-smart-combat-help: Finds every hit near the player in the next 2 minutes and adds an impact shake, FOV pulse and a tiny hit-stop to each.
replay-preset-smart-combat-frame-help: 20 s fixed camera that keeps the player and their nearest enemy both in frame, zooming as they move apart or close in.
replay-preset-smart-kill-cam-help: Jumps to the next death after the playhead: slow motion into it, a frozen orbit round the body, then normal speed.
replay-preset-smart-highlights-help: Scans the whole recording and drops timeline markers on deaths, fights, speech and big building bursts so you can jump between them.
replay-preset-smart-montage-help: Plays stretches with nothing happening (no speech, fights, deaths or building) at 4x for the next 10 minutes, easing back to 1x around the action.
replay-preset-smart-trailer-help: Picks the 8 biggest moments of the rest of the recording, rushes between them at 8x and gives each a punchy cut with an FOV punch and hit-stop.
replay-preset-smart-chase-help: Next 30 s: chase-cam whichever player is moving fastest, switching (at most every 3 s) when someone else takes the lead.
replay-preset-smart-build-cam-help: Finds where blocks get placed or broken in the next 10 minutes and circles that area while it plays back as a 15 s timelapse.
